name: Joshikousei Game's-High!!
source:
The protagonist is a teacher in training who has come to an all girls high school for three weeks to complete his on-site teaching experience required to become a full teacher.

He is the assistant teacher for the 1st year takegumi class, which has many problem children.

The game is an adaptation of the manga/anime Joshi Kousei Girl's High.
translation:
主角是一名正在接受培训的教师，他来到一所女子高中学习三周，以完成成为一名正式教师所需的现场教学经验。

他是问题儿童较多的武组一年级的助教。

该游戏改编自漫画/动画《女子高中》。
